question: The headquarters of ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) is located at:
solution:
The correct option is __Bengaluru.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• The headquarters of ISRO is situated in Bengaluru.__
 
• The Secretariat of DOS and headquarters of ISRO are located at Antariksh Bhavan in Bangaluru.
 
• ISRO has become the 4th space agency to reach Mars after the United States, the Soviet Union, and the European Space Agency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ISRO:

 
 
• Dr Vikram Sarabhai is considered as the founding father of the Indian space programme.
 
• ISRO was formed on 15 August 1969.
 
• **Dr. V. Narayanan** is the current Chairman of ISRO, succeeding S. Somanath in January 2025..
 
• Its vision is to harness space technology for national development while pursuing space science research and planetary exploration.
